optimization_velocity.stage_rationale: 20 iterations, 23 entries. Three battle-tested entries. ~63% tasks seen. Metric has declined/stagnated for 5 iterations from peak of 0.5. However, per-entry metrics remain stable (0 harmful this iteration), suggesting batch composition drives metric variance. Failures this iteration were almost entirely geographic/cultural lock-in — a SPECIFIC, well-understood pattern that the playbook already has entries for (c67e6085, 47e3a943) but they have 0 tests. The primary challenge has two facets: (1) compliance — entries don't fire or aren't followed, (2) coverage depth — entries exist for the right patterns but may need broader triggers. 12 entries at 0 tests is concerning but not harmful.
optimization_velocity.recent_mutation_success_rate: 3/23 entries with strong positive signals (7ca56b8b +6/-0, 06920986 +6/-0, 843d2ff0 +2/-0). 056f0a9e +5/-3 mixed. Most entries untested — insufficient signal to judge mutation success rate.
optimization_velocity.recommendation: The five-iteration metric decline (0.5→0.28→0.28→0.17→0.17) is driven more by batch composition than playbook regression — iter 20's 3 tasks all shared a single failure mode. The playbook's biggest gap is not missing content but non-activation: c67e6085 has the right guidance for 6+ confirmed failure tasks but has 0 tests. Focus on whether trigger design or sampling explains the 12 entries at 0 tests. The c3d022ca addition covers a genuinely new pattern (ignored gold documents). Avoid panic-mode changes based on metric decline.
